name: brain-desk
description: Private marketplace for plan-first orchestration (brain), brainstorm-before-coding (kickoff) and a read-only pre-market brief.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Plan-first orchestration: spend the top-tier model only at decision points and delegate search, build, checking and verification to cheaper agents.

plugins.name: kickoff
plugins.description: Brainstorm-before-coding: turns an idea into a reviewable KICKOFF.md with one top-tier decision and paste-ready agent handoffs, then stops for approval.

plugins.name: premarket-brief
plugins.description: Read-only pre-market brief for a neutral watchlist, with sources, timestamps and a verified / not-verified split. Analysis only.
